named_events.loss_description: Loss experience has been impacted by the US hurricane events of Harvey and Irma in the 2015 and 2016 years of account, although the estimates at year end remained within the syndicate's reinsurance retention and substantially below initial estimates.

data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2017 the syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding at the start of the year was GBP 77.553m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle shows net prior-year adverse development (strengthening) of approximately GBP 27.9m (36% of opening gross reserves), driven primarily by adverse developments related to US hurricane activity (Harvey and Irma) and other claim developments; some older years showed releases which partially offset the deterioration. Foreign exchange effects were also noted in the year. Line-by-line breakdowns in the report are mostly presented net of reinsurance; the gross PYD above was calculated from the published gross claims development triangle.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (PYD) was calculated from the published GROSS claims development triangle (page 29) by excluding the two most recent underwriting years (2017 and 2016) and comparing each older UW year's current estimate to the previous diagonal. No explicit labelled 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' gross figure was provided; the report gives net-by-LOB movement figures only (used for LOB movements as a fallback and flagged as net). RITC activity is present in the underwriting year accounts (2015 RITC into 2016) - the triangle used appears to be the syndicate's gross development table and the PYD calculation excludes the two most recent years, but RITC distortions were considered; users should treat the PYD as derived and not an explicitly stated gross prior-year movement.
